verdict.rationale: Docs show a direct pipeline: user feedback is collected via widget (foreloop-docs-21, foreloop-docs-23), then 'an intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks' (foreloop-docs-12), giving structured tasks with proposed scope from feedback. A PM then approves before agents act (foreloop-docs-7). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the feedback-to-task conversion, and no concrete example showing the actual structured scope/task output format.
